## Set up

1)  R and RStudio

If you don't already have them, install R and RStudio. Open up RStudio where we'll do work.

2)  Install the needed packages, tools and download the desired datasets:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("oxford-pharmacoepi/OmopTrainer")
```
```{r, eval=FALSE}
OmopTrainer::validateSetup()
```
